newsitem.title: INDIA: India ABB falls 5.1 pct after bonus news.
newsitem.headline: India ABB falls 5.1 pct after bonus news.

text.p: The share of Asea Brown Boveri (ABB) fell sharply in early trade at the National Stock Exchange on Friday after a bonus issue announcement fell short of market expectations, brokers said.
The share fell 39.70 rupees, or 5.16 percent, to 729.35. On the Bombay Stock Exchange, the share dropped 34.75 rupees, or 4.5 percent, to 732.25.
The electrical machinery maker announced on Thursday a bonus equity issue of one share for every three shares held. Traders said the market had been expecting one-for-two.
ABB also set interim dividend at three rupees per share.
